WITH picked AS (SELECT event_id FROM "users".delivery_outbox WHERE state='pending' AND available_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at,event_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $1)
 UPDATE "users".delivery_outbox o SET lease_expiry_count=o.lease_expiry_count+CASE WHEN o.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_owner=$2,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+($3::bigint*interval '1 millisecond'),fence=o.fence+1,attempts=o.attempts+1 FROM picked WHERE o.event_id=picked.event_id RETURNING o.event_id,o.subject,o.envelope,o.fence,o.attempts

UPDATE "users".delivery_outbox SET acknowledgement_latency_ms=GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp()-claimed_at))*1000)::bigint,state='published',broker_stream=$4,broker_sequence=$5,published_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,failure_class=NULL WHERE event_id=$1 AND lease_owner=$2 AND fence=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='pending'

UPDATE "users".delivery_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts >= $4 OR $5 <> 'transient' THEN 'quarantined' ELSE 'pending' END,failure_class=$5,available_at=clock_timestamp()+($6::bigint*interval '1 millisecond'),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE event_id=$1 AND lease_owner=$2 AND fence=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='pending'

UPDATE "users".delivery_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN 'quarantined' ELSE state END,failure_class=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN 'transient' ELSE failure_class END,lease_owner=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN NULL ELSE lease_owner END,lease_until=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN NULL ELSE lease_until END WHERE event_id=$1 AND lease_owner=$2 AND fence=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='pending' RETURNING attempts>$4

SELECT kind,identity,definition FROM (
 SELECT 'relation'::text kind,c.relname identity,concat_ws('|',c.relkind::text,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relrowsecurity::text,c.relforcerowsecurity::text) definition FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','S')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',c.relname||'.'||a.attname,concat_ws('|',a.attnum::text,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull::text,a.attidentity::text,coalesce(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'')) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
 UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint',c.relname||'.'||k.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1
 UNION ALL SELECT 'index',c.relname,pg_get_indexdef(c.oid) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind='i'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'trigger',c.relname||'.'||t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND NOT t.tgisinternal
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)||'|'||pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1
 UNION ALL SELECT 'view',c.relname,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind='v'
 ) catalog ORDER BY kind,identity,definition
SET LOCAL search_path TO public

SELECT current_user,r.rolsuper OR r.rolcreatedb OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolbypassrls OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relowner=r.oid AND c.relnamespace NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname LIKE 'pg_%')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND (pg_has_role(current_user,n.nspowner,'MEMBER') OR has_schema_privilege(current_user,n.oid,'CREATE'))) FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user
SELECT registry_digest,interface_digest,reader_min_version,migrations FROM migration_control.readiness($1)
SELECT has_schema_privilege(current_user,$1,'CREATE') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND pg_has_role(current_user,n.nspowner,'MEMBER'))
SELECT epoch,region FROM recovery.current_epoch()
SELECT has_function_privilege($1,$2,$3)
SELECT has_sequence_privilege($1,$2,$3)
SELECT has_column_privilege($1,$2,$3,$4)
SELECT has_table_privilege($1,$2,$3)

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,p.privilege,has_table_privilege($1,c.oid,p.privilege),has_table_privilege($1,c.oid,p.privilege||' WITH GRANT OPTION') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('SELECT'),('INSERT'),('UPDATE'),('DELETE'),('TRUNCATE'),('REFERENCES'),('TRIGGER')) p(privilege) WHERE n.nspname=ANY($2) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v')

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,a.attname,p.privilege,has_column_privilege($1,c.oid,a.attnum,p.privilege),has_column_privilege($1,c.oid,a.attnum,p.privilege||' WITH GRANT OPTION') FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('SELECT'),('INSERT'),('UPDATE'),('REFERENCES')) p(privilege) WHERE n.nspname=ANY($2) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped

SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),has_function_privilege($1,p.oid,'EXECUTE'),has_function_privilege($1,p.oid,'EXECUTE WITH GRANT OPTION') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY($2)

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,p.privilege,has_sequence_privilege($1,c.oid,p.privilege),has_sequence_privilege($1,c.oid,p.privilege||' WITH GRANT OPTION') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('USAGE'),('SELECT'),('UPDATE')) p(privilege) WHERE n.nspname=ANY($2) AND c.relkind='S'
